summary: Grab Holdings furnished a Form 6-K containing its Q3 2026 earnings release rather than a transactional announcement. The routine results (revenue $1,112M, +27% YoY; profit $18M; Adjusted EBITDA $237M; TTM adjusted free cash flow $533M) are the primary disclosure, but the release also states Grab repurchased $400 million of shares in September and October 2026, leaving $500 million remaining under its buyback program. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock was disclosed. The capital-return element is incremental to ordinary reporting, so watch for further buyback execution and any program expansion.
